ns2:course.label: Professional Development
ns2:course.description: Provides students with a capstone experience near graduation to enhance their educations with advanced professional experiences tailored to their career needs and/or to strengthen perceived areas of weakness in their professional education and development. No graduate credit. 8 professional hours. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: VM 616 and good-standing in the veterinary professional curriculum.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: No graduate credit. 8 professional hours. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: VM 616 and good-standing in the veterinary professional curriculum.
